lines.text: I ate your cake! Just kidding.

data.define: Used after a joke to show you didn't mean it.

example.text: I ate your cake! Just kidding.

misuse.text: Don't say 'just kidding' after a serious insult.

publish.title: What does "just kidding" mean?
publish.value: Just kidding = I was only joking. Example: "I ate your cake! Just kidding." (casual English).
